question: Where can I find museum inside 100 kilometers as I travel from Arsenal Contemporary Art, New York, NY toward True Life Care Center, Morris Plains, NJ?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'museum' AND ST_Intersects( geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Arsenal Contemporary Art%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%True Life Care Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Morris Plains%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1) )::geography, 100000 ) );
